location.title: Location
location.description: Free-text place name to geocode (e.g. "Yosemite Valley, California"). Ignored if `coordinates` is set.

coordinates.sectionDescription: For when you know precisely where you will be standing. Filling both fields in overrides Location and skips geocoding; leaving the section untouched geocodes the place name above.
coordinates.title: Coordinates
coordinates.description: Latitude and longitude in decimal degrees. Set both fields or neither — a half-filled pair fails the run rather than guessing the other half.

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Decimal degrees; positive north, negative south. Yosemite Valley is 37.7456. Convert other notations first: 37°44'44"N is 37.7456.

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: Decimal degrees; positive east, negative west. Yosemite Valley is -119.5936. Convert other notations first: 119°35'37"W is -119.5936.
